title: Phase 1+BWL
body:
I've been able to say with all the latest changes phase 1 is complete. BWL has been completely balanced as well.
I was able to complete and do all BWL boss's on a rogue.
git commit:https://github.com/m0nnnna/wow/commit/0e48026d14ae30ed9c82671f004a489c34633646
main points of interest:
-Removed Nef mind control - Was causing resets during ad phase when solo.
-Lowered Nef ads from 40 > 10
-Lowered egg count from 30 > 10
-Removed surpression room effect entirely
-Removed stun effect from chromaggus
-Balance changes for each BWL boss complete
-Lowered health, DPS, CC, and some minor armor value changes
-Buff Lifeward from 5.45% chance to 25% chance
-Buff Lifeward from 309 heal to 610 heal
-Removed custom module Dungeonrespawn due to issues in prod

As always please submit any issues to help@nekos.farm
